title: A ratatui screen draws the transcript and an input line
body:
No screen exists.

## Proposal

`src/ui.rs`: one function that draws a `Transcript` and an input line into a
ratatui frame. Entries are wrapped at the width; the view scrolls to keep the
newest entry visible unless the user scrolled up; the input line is one row
at the bottom with a cursor. A tool call shows its kind, title and status on
one line and its locations under it. Thoughts are dimmed. That is all for the
first version; how it should look is Jack's call and comes after.

## Out of scope

- Markdown rendering. Agent text is shown as it arrives.
- Selection and copy; the terminal does that.
close_reason: Done in the commit titled 'Run a first ACP session against a scripted agent' on dev, 2026-11-06. The hello scenario plays through the fake agent, in process and over stdio, into the same transcript, and the screen shows it under tmux. Visual design is untouched on purpose; that is Jack's to direct.
